summary: The TypeScript SDK's core-bridge component ships with four known Cargo dependency vulnerabilities with available fixes. A patch release is needed to bump quinn-proto, rustls-webpki, and tar to resolve CVEs detected by container image vulnerability scanners.
userImpact: Teams using vulnerability scanning tools in CI/CD must suppress CVEs to pass security gates, weakening their security controls.
rootCause: Outdated Cargo dependencies with known CVEs (quinn-proto 0.11.13, rustls-webpki 0.103.9, tar 0.4.44) not updated to patch versions with fixes.
proposedFix: Run `cargo update -p quinn-proto -p webpki -p tar` in core-bridge and cut a patch release.
workaround: Suppress detected CVEs via `.trivyignore` file in CI/CD vulnerability scanning.
resolutionDetails: Dependencies were bumped and released in version 1.16.0.
keyQuote: These dependencies have been bumped as of 1.16.0
